everyday.name: Buttons & toggles
everyday.description: Clear actions with variants, loading states, icon buttons, and grouped toggles.

everyday.name: Form controls
everyday.description: Checkboxes, radios, switches, sliders, and progress that feel native in a dense tool.

everyday.name: Text field & text area
everyday.description: Single-line and multiline input with validation, selection, undo, and IME support.

everyday.name: Select & combobox
everyday.description: Filterable, keyboard-friendly choices with virtualized options when lists get large.

everyday.name: Menus
everyday.description: Dropdowns, context menus, submenus, checkable items, and visible shortcuts.

everyday.name: Overlays
everyday.description: Tooltips, popovers, dialogs, sheets, and toasts with predictable focus behavior.

everyday.name: Navigation
everyday.description: Tabs, sidebars, breadcrumbs, and segmented controls for app-scale navigation.

everyday.name: Collections
everyday.description: Virtual lists, trees, and data tables for structured, keyboard-navigable data.

everyday.name: Layout helpers
everyday.description: Resizable split panes, scroll areas, form layouts, and separators.

everyday.name: Calendar
everyday.description: A keyboard navigable month grid for single dates and ranges.

everyday.name: Date picker
everyday.description: Typed dates and range selection with a shared calendar popover.

everyday.name: Disclosure
everyday.description: Collapsible sections and accordion groups for dense panels.

everyday.name: Toolbar
everyday.description: Actions, toggles, separators, and explicit overflow in one row.

everyday.name: Time fields
everyday.description: Segmented time entry in 12 or 24 hour mode, plus date and time composition.

everyday.name: Display primitives
everyday.description: Badges, avatars, shortcut hints, and links for compact metadata.

everyday.name: Inline messages
everyday.description: Inline alerts and empty states with helpful actions.

everyday.name: Search field
everyday.description: Search input with clear action, optional result count, and focus shortcut.

everyday.name: Tag input
everyday.description: Add, validate, and remove tags with optional suggestions.

everyday.name: File input
everyday.description: Drop files or browse, filter selections, and remove chosen files.

everyday.name: Reorderable list
everyday.description: Reorder items by drag or keyboard with a visible insertion target.

everyday.name: Menu bar
everyday.description: An in-window application menu bar backed by the same command model as native menus.

everyday.name: Status bar
everyday.description: Compact leading and trailing status, actions, and progress.

everyday.name: Stepper
everyday.description: A guided multi-step flow with validation, progress, and back/next actions.

pro.name: Viewport
pro.description: A pan-and-zoom surface for canvases, image viewers, and editors.

pro.name: Scrubbable number field
pro.description: Drag to tune a value, click to type, and use modifiers for fine or coarse steps.

pro.name: Precision slider
pro.description: Fine-drag, reset, bipolar mode, and value feedback for exact adjustments.

pro.name: Curve editor
pro.description: Tone-curve editing with channel tabs, smooth interpolation, and keyboard nudging.

pro.name: Colour tools
pro.description: Colour wheel, numeric formats, eyedropper, and grading wheels for image work.

pro.name: Gradient editor
pro.description: Add, move, and edit ordered stops with a direct preview of the result.

pro.name: Histogram
pro.description: Read-only luminance and RGB distributions with optional clipping indicators.

pro.name: Property inspector
pro.description: Data-driven grouped properties with type-specific editors and mixed values.

pro.name: Timeline
pro.description: Tracks, clips, playhead, zoomable time ruler, snapping, and keyframes.

pro.name: Node editor
pro.description: Pannable graphs with nodes, ports, connections, box selection, and minimap.

pro.name: Layer panel
pro.description: Reorderable layers with visibility, locking, thumbnails, and groups.

pro.name: Command palette
pro.description: Fuzzy search over registered actions with their keybindings close at hand.

pro.name: Shortcut editor
pro.description: View and rebind actions with conflict detection and a serializable keymap.

pro.name: Laika seeds
pro.description: Proven controls extracted from Laika and rewritten to the mkit spec.
pro.note: Laika's controls were compared with the mkit slider, segmented control, and histogram drafts. Laika pins GPUI 0.3.2 while mkit pins 0.3.5, so direct component adoption needs dependency alignment and behavior preservation before the controls can move across.
